why: `package` is required and `node` is not, and this is why. Without a package there is no question — nothing names a corpus to check against — so a call omitting it is a tool error. Without a node there IS a question, and its answer is a finding the gate would also give, so it comes back as one rather than as a schema error. A server that made `node` required would have moved a frozen check id out of reach of the surface that exists to report it.
